comment_text.value:
hey HN, i built an npm library - browser-whisper. it's an abstraction over libraries that lets you transcribe audio/videos completely in the browser using local models, with no api key and no server

it currently supports two runtimes - transformers.js and parakeet.js. think of it like a shadcn ecosystem but for in-browser STT models - you can plug n play this feature into your app with just 3 lines of code. in simple words, it's infra shipped with third-party models, and super fast to run in the browser, powered by WebGPU.

the latest parakeet model, has low enough latency to build simple Wispr Flow-style apps completely free of cost and in browser

repo - github.com/tanpreetjolly/browser-whisper (MIT License). i'd love feedback.

story_title.value: Show HN: Audio Transcription in Browser with WebGPU
